identified_issues: Breaker BKR_512 was actuated without an approved, pre-authorized Switching Order registered in DISPATCH_EMS prior to physical actuation, violating Section 4.2.1.
Attempted post-event authorization via retrospective ticket SO-2026-8812 cannot cure the unauthorized switching action pursuant to Section 4.2.3.
evidence: DISPATCH_EMS registry recorded no switching order on file and pre-authorization status as NONE at 15:45:00.000Z and 15:50:00.000Z.
RELAY_SEL_451 logged manual breaker trip execution at 16:10:02.100Z, transitioning BKR_512 to OPEN at 16:10:02.145Z prior to any authorization.
DISPATCH_EMS log EMS_LOG_9941 registered ticket SO-2026-8812 retrospectively at 16:12:15.000Z with status RETROSPECTIVE_UNAUTHORIZED.
recommended_action: Uphold the compliance infraction notice and mark the operation as FAIL. Initiate an operational governance review and retrain substation personnel on pre-switching authorization requirements under Regional Grid Operating Standard Section 4.2.
